descriptions.job-16h67jw:
About us

Relay is a cross-chain payments protocol that provides instant, low-cost cross-chain bridging, swaps, and transactions. We're the fastest and cheapest way to bridge and transact across chains, serving over 5 million users who have completed 59+ million transactions with $6+ billion in volume across 85+ chains.

Our company mission is to make transacting across chains as fast, cheap, and reliable as online payments. We are building the core infrastructure to abstract chains from end user payments, enabling the next billion users to experience the benefits of blockchain without the UX burdens.

About the role

The Liquidity team keeps Relay's liquidity reliable, competitively priced, capital-efficient, and within its risk framework. Every partner deal our BD team signs depends on it: the price of each route, how much can move in one order, how partner loans are placed and repaid, and whether a new chain or asset is ready on launch day.

As Trading Desk Lead, you will run that desk. The closest equivalent is running an OTC desk or an electronic market-making desk: you price partner flow and manage inventory within limits, and there is no proprietary book. You will own the flow of deals between BD and Liquidity, set prices and limits within the framework set by the Head of Liquidity, sign off on what we commit to before contracts are signed, take each non-standard deal from request to launch, and lead daily liquidity operations with our operations engineers and quant developers. The aim is for Liquidity to work with BD the way a market maker works with its clients: standard requests answered from a catalog, and everything else priced with a clear cost basis, a floor and conditions.

This is not a manual execution role. We work agentic-first: AI agents handle intake triage, first-draft pricing, record keeping, status updates and monitoring. You design that flow, check the output and make the decisions, and you remain accountable for prices, commitments and risk. The aim is a deal flow that gets faster as volume grows, without adding a person per deal.

How this role differs from Quant and BD

  • BD owns the partner relationship: it finds deals, negotiates the commercial terms and signs the agreements. It brings requests to the desk and quotes standard routes from the catalog.

  • Our quant developers build the models behind pricing, hedging and rebalancing, and draft prices for incoming requests. They own the methods, not the commitments.

  • The Trading Desk Lead turns both into decisions: sets prices and limits within the framework set by the Head of Liquidity, decides what we commit to before signature, runs each deal to launch and leads daily operations. In bank or market-maker terms, BD is sales, the quants are the strats, and this role is the desk head who owns the prices and limits.

What you'll do

Run the deal desk with BD

  • Own intake and triage for every deal request, and give each one an owner, a date and a clear answer.

  • Price routes, order sizes and partner loans with the quant developers, within delegated limits; escalate below-floor requests with a recommendation.

  • Review term sheets and contracts before signature for what we can deliver and configure: rates, caps, SLAs, loan terms, notice periods and repricing rights.

Take deals from signature to launch

  • Run each non-standard deal as a project: a delivery plan with owners and dates across BD, Legal, Finance, our Customer team and Liquidity engineering.

  • Hand-hold the Liquidity side of partner onboarding: loan transfers, test transactions, limits and launch checks.

  • Review each deal after launch and close the loop with BD.

Automate and improve the deal flow

  • Map the flow from request to launch, measure where the time goes, and remove steps.

  • Build agents and tools for intake triage, first-draft pricing, deal records, status updates and monitoring.

  • Keep a deal register, a register of signed obligations, a route catalog (standard prices, floors and maximum sizes) and a capacity view current, so BD can answer standard requests without the desk.

Lead daily operations and counterparties

  • Lead the follow-the-sun operations rotation and its handoffs.

  • Own limits and incident command for liquidity incidents in your hours, and escalate business-critical decisions.

  • Track partner loans from receipt to repayment.

  • Own relationships with market makers, OTC desks, exchanges, bridges and lenders, including fee terms and service levels.

  • Turn recurring deal problems into product and engineering requests.

About you

  • You've run a desk, a book or a deal pipeline, and you price from the cost basis up.

  • You read a contract and see what it commits the desk to.

  • You make decisions within your authority, write them down, and escalate early when a request falls outside it.

  • You're direct with commercial teams about what can and can't be done, and you offer an alternative when the answer is no.

  • You stay calm in incidents and keep people informed.

  • You work AI-first and think in processes: you map a flow, measure it, and automate or remove the slowest step. You've automated your own job before, and you validate what agents produce.

  • You run cross-team projects to a date and follow up until they're done.

  • You're excited about crypto and the mechanics of cross-chain liquidity.

Skills and abilities

Must-have

  • 6+ years in trading, market making, OTC or institutional liquidity, or treasury, including 2+ years leading a desk, a book or a deal pipeline.

  • Strong pricing skills: spreads, inventory and capital cost, execution and rebalancing cost, depeg and counterparty risk.

  • Experience reviewing commercial terms with legal and finance teams.

  • Experience running live risk within limits and leading incident response.

  • Strong knowledge of crypto market structure: centralized exchanges, OTC, stablecoins, bridges and on-chain liquidity.

  • A track record of automating desk or operations workflows with scripts, tools or AI agents.

  • Experience running cross-team projects such as client onboardings or launches, with owners and dates.

  • Comfortable with data: SQL or equivalent, spreadsheets and dashboards.

Nice to have

  • Client-facing liquidity or FX experience at a bank, prime broker, exchange or market maker.

  • Loan, credit-line or collateral management.

  • Stablecoin issuers, payments or cross-chain settlement.

  • Python or TypeScript, enough to build your own tools.

  • Experience setting up a deal desk, an RFQ workflow or a client onboarding process.

  • Experience managing or mentoring operations staff.

Location and hours

  • Remote. Americas time zones preferred (UTC-3 to UTC-6); Europe considered with at least four hours of overlap with US East Coast business hours.

  • The role needs accounts with global exchanges whose eligibility rules exclude some jurisdictions, including the United States and Canada. We can only consider candidates located outside those jurisdictions.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary

  • Equity package

  • Comprehensive health benefits

  • Unlimited PTO policy with encouraged minimum

  • Remote-first culture with emphasis on collaboration, communication, and flexibility

About the Company

Rain is the global stablecoin payments platform for enterprises, neobanks, platforms, developers, and AI agents. Our technology allows partners to move, store, and use stablecoins instantly and compliantly through global payment cards, rewards, on/offramps, wallets, and cross-border rails. As both a Visa and Mastercard Principal Member, Rain issues cards that work at more than 175 million merchant locations in over 220 countries and territories. Built natively for stablecoins and trusted by more than 100 organizations worldwide, Rain delivers secure, scalable infrastructure that makes money move freely and instantly around the world.

You will have the opportunity to deliver massive impact at a hypergrowth company backed by some of the top investors in fintech, crypto, and SaaS. In January 2026, we closed a $250M Series C led by ICONIQ, valuing Rain at $1.95B, with Sapphire Ventures, Norwest, Galaxy Ventures, Dragonfly, Bessemer Venture Partners, FirstMark, Lightspeed, and Endeavor Catalyst also participating. If you're curious, bold, and excited to help shape a borderless financial future, we'd love to talk.

Our Ethos

We believe in an open and flat structure. You will be able to grow into the role that most aligns with your goals. Our team members at all levels have the freedom to explore ideas and impact the roadmap and vision of our company.

About the role

Rain builds payments and stablecoin infrastructure. Finance, Risk, Compliance, and our partners rely on data from card transactions, settlements, ledger entries, and onchain transfers.

We’re looking for a Data Engineer with batch and streaming experience to bring this data into our warehouse and keep it correct. You’ll build scalable, idempotent pipelines that handle late and duplicate data and alert us when something breaks.

At Rain, everyone models data, writes production-quality code, and automates their own workflows. We use AI to speed up repetitive work, but we own and check the results. In this role, you’ll automate ingestion and quality checks so new sources come online quickly and stay trustworthy.

What you’ll do

  • Build scalable batch and streaming pipelines, choosing the right approach for latency, cost, and correctness.

  • Process events near real time, handling deduplication, windowing, and late or out-of-order events.

  • Own batch ingestion from databases (CDC), files (SFTP and GCS), APIs, and onchain sources.

  • Build incremental dbt models that handle late data, duplicates, CDC deletes, and backfills; reconcile streaming and batch outputs.

  • Orchestrate pipelines in Dagster with sensors, schedules, and alerts.

  • Add freshness, volume, and reconciliation checks to every source, and fix root causes.

  • Work with backend pods on event and table contracts to prevent downstream breakage.

  • Partner with Analytics Engineers, Data Scientists, and Risk on their data needs, including ML features.

What you’ll need

  • At least 3 years building production data solutions, including owning both batch and streaming pipelines end to end, from source to warehouse.

  • Experience designing data solutions at scale.

  • Strong SQL and Python / Rust, plus experience with a cloud data warehouse such as BigQuery, ClickHouse, or Snowflake and an understanding of their trade-offs.

  • Streaming experience with tools such as Pub/Sub, Kafka, Dataflow/Beam, or Flink.

  • Batch experience with dbt and an orchestrator such as Dagster or Airflow.

  • Experience with production data quality testing, monitoring, and reconciliation.

  • Ability to debug across the source database, pipeline, warehouse, and report.

  • Ability to use AI tools to learn and work faster while checking their output.

Nice to have

  • Building offline and real-time ML feature pipelines, such as fraud or risk features.

  • Working with payments, banking, or blockchain data, including EVM or Solana events and indexers.

  • Using CDC and ingestion tools such as Datastream, Debezium, Meltano, Fivetran, or Airbyte.
